entities.title: One pilot per device
entities.summary: Two people play together only online, each on their own device.
entities.impact: Friends in the same room need a device each.

entities.title: Nine pilots at most
entities.summary: An online game takes the first nine slots in the room; a game holds at most nine ships.
entities.impact: A tenth player in the lobby's match would not fly.

entities.title: Online games can't be paused
entities.summary: An online game goes on whatever one pilot does.
entities.impact: A pilot who looks away keeps flying; a hidden tab or a slow connection makes the others wait.

entities.title: A pilot who leaves stays in the game
entities.summary: A pilot who leaves an online game keeps an idle ship there until it is lost.
entities.impact: The game goes on until that idle ship, and everyone else's, are out of lives; in co-op it can't help, and in versus its score still counts.

entities.title: Offline games can't enter the public table
entities.summary: A game the server issued no seed for still plays, but its scores stay on the device.
entities.impact: A player whose connection drops before the game, or an online game whose host got no seed, can't reach the public table.
entities.workaround: Start another game once the connection is back.

entities.title: Ninety-minute replays
entities.summary: The server replays games of up to 90 minutes, and seeds expire after 24 hours unused.
entities.impact: A longer game, or one submitted a day later, is refused.

entities.title: Plain names
entities.summary: Names are up to 12 plain characters; accents are dropped and a few letters spelled out (Þór becomes Thor).
entities.impact: Names in other scripts cannot be shown.

entities.title: A deploy can refuse games in progress
entities.summary: A game started before a deploy that changes the engine is replayed by the new engine.
entities.impact: Its recording may no longer replay to a whole game, and is refused.
